_doc: MB, PSS/RSS per app INCLUDING its FUSE stub (0 once U1 ships). 'target' = the owner's goal on a real GPU desktop, background state: per-app budgets sum to 365 PSS / 484 RSS, fleet cap 500/500; they assume U1+W1+W0+WH1+CB1a+W3b (memory.md section 4). 'xvfb' = what CI can enforce under llvmpipe: identical except Clipboard 260/335 (the Flutter engine is ~2.3x larger on llvmpipe; drop this allowance when the engine leaves the resident process, CB1b). 'open' and 'closed' caps are ratchets for the one-window case, set from CI measurements and only lowered (Tools open PSS 281 = the higher of two CI runs on Link 1.0.2, 267.7, plus 5 %; Tools docs/v1/DECISIONS.md D10) (WebKit window RSS < 500 is not reachable without a UX trade-off, section 6).

perf._doc: perf_budget.py (ARCADE_APP.md RT-6, PERF-2), per app: ms from launch to the window being mapped (cold: nothing of the app running; show: running in the background with its window closed and its memory released); idle CPU in % of one core and wakeups (context switches per second, whole tree) in the background, with the default page open for 60 s and after closing it; disk_mb for everything the app puts in a fresh profile (installed copy, unpacked runtime, data, caches). Set from measurements with headroom; Xvfb/llvmpipe is slower than a GPU desktop.
